description: Baseline prompting strategy comparison and lexical evaluation metrics

A_structured_fewshot.description: System prompt with 3 worked examples in target JSON schema
A_structured_fewshot.key_finding: Best schema compliance but still hallucinated prices on numerical queries

B_chain_of_thought.key_finding: Better reasoning structure but slower; still invented numbers

C_decomposition.description: Break query into sub-tasks before answering
C_decomposition.key_finding: Best factual recall but still failed on numerical queries

lexical_metrics.note: Reference answers are concise gold summaries (1-2 sentences); agent produces detailed multi-paragraph responses. Moderate ROUGE/BLEU scores are expected. Primary metric is task completion rate.

key_finding: All three prompting strategies failed on numerical queries (budget estimation, transport comparison) because the 8B model invented prices. This motivated the multi-agent architecture where numerical computation is removed from the LLM entirely.
